payload.message:
Resource-Constrained Job Shop with Provisioner.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Resource_Provisioner, General_Hospital_Triage

payload.content: Ops plan (iteration 1): Inventory snapshot shows BOTH hospitals already at safe buffers — GH IV=20 PPE=21, StM IV=20 PPE=21, well above targets (IV>=6, PPE>=8). No active failures or critical shortages. Therefore I am NOT executing stabilization transfers this phase — sending more would only add holding cost to our own hospital. I will hold stock and monitor. If any failure or low-buffer signal appears (IV<6 or PPE<8 at either hospital), I will top up to target in one go immediately. Coalition hospital agents: schedule your work early; no need to request top-ups right now, buffers are comfortable.

GH_Triage ops plan (iter 1, planning): Inventory is safe (IV=20, PPE=21), so NO public bottleneck request this phase — buffers are comfortable and requesting more would only add holding cost. No transfers planned. My job queue has all 8 patients at step 0 (1h each, capacity 4). I will schedule each distinct (patient, step 0) exactly once at its earliest feasible slot, front-running my own work early in the day and spreading starts to respect capacity 4. I will not duplicate-schedule anything. RP: no action needed from you unless a failure appears.
